title: Comment it out
description:
A comment is text the compiler ignores. Programmers often "comment out" a line to switch it off without deleting it.

Switch off the middle line with `//` so the program prints only:

```
Keep this line
Keep this one too
```

Do not delete anything.
hints: Put `//` at the start of the line you want switched off. Everything after `//` on that line is ignored. (Ctrl+/ does it for you.)

examples.name: prints two lines
examples.expected:
Keep this line
Keep this one too

tests.name: prints two lines
tests.expected:
Keep this line
Keep this one too
